title: A System Design Report for Grid Enhancement Technology: Maximizing Transmission Power Delivery via Dynamic Line Rating
summary: System design report describing a Dynamic Line Rating system's architecture, risk reduction work, test plan, and project management for a senior design project.
notes: Prose-heavy report combining design description (3.0), risk reduction (3.2), test plan (3.3), and project management (4.0). No single locked architectural decision (no Status/Accepted field), no user-story-driven PRD structure, and no isolated API/schema contract structure — classified as general DOC/context. Some sections (3.3 Test Plan) resemble SPEC-like acceptance criteria but are embedded in a broader narrative report rather than a standalone technical specification.
